item.title: Blit 1.0.2
item.description: Blit 1.0.2. Clear Queue… removes every transfer from the queue at once (in the queue panel, the strip's right-click menu and View › Clear Queue…): running transfers stop, queued and paused ones are cancelled, and finished ones are cleared. Files already transferred stay, and a download's part files stay so it can be resumed. Once a license is entered, the Blit menu shows License… in place of Buy Blit… and Enter License….
